question: Among item lines belonging to 2025 orders, how many have a non-zero difference between recorded line amount and price times quantity? Give the signed sum and absolute sum of those differences in INR. Do positive and negative differences offset in this snapshot?

action.query: SELECT COUNT_IF(i.LINE_AMOUNT - (i.PRICE * i.QUANTITY) <> 0) AS NONZERO_DIFFERENCE_LINE_COUNT, SUM(IFF(i.LINE_AMOUNT - (i.PRICE * i.QUANTITY) <> 0, i.LINE_AMOUNT - (i.PRICE * i.QUANTITY), 0)) AS SIGNED_DIFFERENCE_SUM_INR, SUM(IFF(i.LINE_AMOUNT - (i.PRICE * i.QUANTITY) <> 0, ABS(i.LINE_AMOUNT - (i.PRICE * i.QUANTITY)), 0)) AS ABSOLUTE_DIFFERENCE_SUM_INR FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER_ITEM i JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND o.CURRENCY = 'INR'

action.answer: Among item lines belonging to orders recorded in 2025 with currency INR, 21,466 lines had a non-zero difference, defined as recorded LINE_AMOUNT minus PRICE × QUANTITY. The signed sum of these differences was INR 23,791.00, and their absolute sum was INR 23,791.00. Positive and negative differences did not offset: the signed sum equaling the absolute sum indicates the non-zero differences were all positive in this snapshot.
